title: Commons Phase 1: find and inspect the Mac/frame journey end to end
statement: Situation, record and selected passage live in the URL; a 'Before you rely on it' panel compares the reader's words with recorded conditions (word comparison, labelled), lists limit, correction passages and unknowns; recorded outcomes are shown with passage links; loading, failed-load/retry, not-found and unknown-passage states keep the situation and way back. New journey smoke (22 checks, added to CI) asserts rendered quotes equal the corpus. No backend or CLI/MCP/HTTP contract change. No human review recorded.
conditions: Builds on the unreviewed Phase 0 finding commons-phase0-checkpoint-2026-11-01; tokens remain provisional.
Checked in Chromium only; screen reader, touch and other browsers not run.
The fixed 'Unknown' wording and the word-comparison presentation need human review.
